title: Boost your projects with figures
text: is an online editor designed specifically for images used in academic texts, and documents. It provides custom-tailored tools for visual editing in a clean and organized environment.
text2: Your images are not uploaded anywhere, they stay in your browser.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: All mage processing runs locally in browser, ensuring your data never leaves your device. This approach provides maximum privacy and security.

pdf.title: PDF vector processing
pdf.description: PDF files are processed as vector graphics, preserving their structure and quality. This allows precise edits and annotations without rasterization.

tools.title: Specialized Tools
tools.description: Designed specifically for technical and academic documents. Focus on clarity, precision, and efficient workflows tailored to your needs.

crop.title: Crop
crop.description: Crop the image manually or use Fit Crop to automatically remove unnecessary background and focus on the important content.

points.title: Manual crop
points.text: Select and adjust a rectangular area using the mouse or exact position and size values.

points.title: Aspect ratio lock
points.text: Keep consistent proportions while resizing the crop area.

points.title: Fit Crop
points.text: Automatically detect and remove background-like edges from the image.

points.title: Sensitivity control
points.text: Adjust how aggressively the background is detected during automatic cropping.

frame.title: Frame
frame.description: Add visual frames around your image, including device and window styles, to create polished and presentation-ready outputs.

points.title: Frame types
points.text: Choose from solid, browser window, or phone frame styles.

points.title: Custom dimensions
points.text: Adjust frame width and layout using precise units, including millimeters.

points.title: Visual customization
points.text: Modify colors, outlines, headers, and additional frame elements.

points.title: Device simulation
points.text: Wrap screenshots in realistic phone or desktop environments.

blur.title: Blur area
blur.description: Blur selected parts of the image to hide details or guide attention to important areas.

points.title: Precise positioning
points.text: Define the exact position and size of the blur area.

points.title: Blur strength
points.text: Control how strong the blur effect is applied.

points.title: Edge fade
points.text: Smooth the edges of the blur for a more natural look.

points.title: Focus control
points.text: Highlight important content by reducing visual noise around it.
